explanation:
The central tree retains all seven major branches while shrinking from 151 to 102 lines (32.5%) and from 10,860 to 7,156 characters (34.1%). Eight peripheral trees expand review, prompts, capture, execution, materialization, assessment and publication. [M] denotes modular structure and public/internal boundaries; [C] calls; [O] ownership and lifetime; [D] data dependencies. Cross-diagram edges attach to the concepts being expanded. Positions account for actual tree dimensions and leave gaps.

Corrections grounded in the pinned sources: ExperimentService.relaunch calls launchEdited, which calls forkForAttempt before startRequest; the seed placed the fork before launchEdited. CompareSessionService.capture checks checkpoint/view availability, while createPinned checks diagram revision identity. The linked materializer returns a structured clone, so 'frozen' is expressed as retained independent data rather than runtime immutability. Request-hash conflict checking is qualified as checking stored runs: launchPrepared first coalesces in-flight calls by ID. Sources: experimentService.ts:188-215; evalRunService.ts:295-300,457-476; compareSessionService.ts:96-173; linkedCanvasesMaterializer.ts:78-89.

Additional source-grounded details include explicit parents forcing prompt versions while contentHash hashes stage text only; hidden experiment bookkeeping; approval recovery receipts; omitted revision-parent boundaries; directed jump reachability; root-first linked output; label-and-line edge reanchoring; comparison-specific deletion; and publication guards. These come from evalPromptService.ts, experimentService.ts, compareSessionService.ts, both supplied materializers, judgementService.ts and evalRunService.ts.

Only the point definition, pinned source text and seed supply codebase evidence. Imported implementations such as executeFewShot, the history runner, alternative materializers and LegacyGenerationAdapter are absent. Their internals are therefore left as delegation boundaries or explicitly declared workflow contracts. Runtime configuration is shown from agentContextEvalRuntime.ts; external runtime behavior and catalog transaction guarantees are not inferred.

|-- [C] materializeAttachment creates Pinned parent, then forks Attached roll-up
|-- [D] Consume each r2 diagram exactly once: placement or merge
|   |-- Reject repeated/unknown parent edits and colliding placed diagram IDs
|   `-- Strategy a: no edits; b: edits without merges; c: at least one merge

|   `-- Prefer history artifact, then retained result, then canvas/checkpoint
